instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: All right, so it's actually going to be the same C shape, but it's going to just be turned around, right? Just rotated 180, right? So you're going to have green, red, green. This is in the right half of the grid, but the open bit of the C is facing away from you. So, oh, it's, yeah, green, red, green.

assumptions: The 'C shape' is formed by a vertical red block (axis=y) as the spine and two horizontal green blocks (axis=z) as the arms.
The phrase 'open bit of the C is facing away from you' means the concave side of the C is oriented towards z=0 (away from the viewer).
The C shape is centered in the x-dimension of the right half of the grid.
evidence: it's actually going to be the same C shape
This is in the right half of the grid
but the open bit of the C is facing away from you.

validation_error: A ground block extends beyond the illustrative grid.
